card.statement: [<<cite:MT>> Theorem 2] Let $T(L)$ be a generic tableau, the vector space $V(T(L)) = \Span {\mathcal B}(T(L))$ has a structure of a $U_q$-module of finite length with action of the generators of $U_q$ given by the Gelfand-Tsetlin formulae (<<ref:Gelfand-Tsetlin formulas>>).
card.label: Theorem 10

paper.title: Irreducible subquotients of generic Gelfand-Tsetlin modules over $U_{q}(\mathfrak{gl}_n)$
paper.abstract: We provide a classification and explicit bases of tableaux of all irreducible subquotients of generic Gelfand-Tsetlin modules over Uq(gl(n)) where q different 1 and -1.
